capabilities: Send note lines as OpenTodo tasks
Link tasks back to origin notes
Parse Tasks plugin and quick-add syntax
Sync a vault folder two-way with OpenTodo
Queue offline sends and encrypt account data
disambiguation: Not a task manager inside Obsidian; it only sends lines to, and syncs a folder with, your own OpenTodo server.
extras: Sets no hotkeys; the API token is kept in Obsidian's device storage, not the vault; no analytics or update checks; not yet listed in the community directory (install by hand or with BRAT).
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn note lines into tasks on your own server with links back to the note, or to keep a folder of task files in sync with it.

relations.evidence: Send a line, or a selection of lines, from any note to your own OpenTodo server as tasks
is read like the Tasks plugin and OpenTodo's vault

requires.name: OpenTodo API token with Full scope

summary: Bridge to a self-hosted OpenTodo server that sends note lines as tasks linked back to the note and syncs a folder of task files two-way.
